name: Regeneration Mist · Death
primary:
A zone at the aim point with a 4.5-block radius for 10 s. Every second, on everyone inside, including you (damage and control only hit enemies):
• Soaked for 8 s
• Heals 1 ❤
• Regeneration: +0.5 ❤ every 2 s for 6 s
• Growth: up to 2 nearby blocks — crops +2 stages, dirt turns to grass, roots grow upward
• Revives the nearest fallen player or creature within 4.5 blocks with 30% health
• Puts out fire
• Blindness for 2 s
• Withering: −0.5 ❤ per second for 4 s
• Life drain: 0.5 ❤ damage, you heal 0.2 ❤
